payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source, is the surrounding setting rendered as a drawing made from chalk?
node.criteria: Pass if the background and foreground setting coherently read as chalk drawing, including the vegetation, hillside, sky, ground and visible structures. Ground the judgment in the appearance of marks, textures, shading and forms across representative regions. Fail if the setting remains substantially photographic or merely blurred, smeared or grain-filtered without a convincing chalk-drawing medium impression. Simplification and smudging can be valid chalk techniques but are not sufficient by themselves. Do not require a particular palette or chalk technique. Unknown if either image is unavailable or the visual evidence is insufficient.
node.binding: Compare the surrounding setting in the source and edited images to assess its transformation into chalk drawing. Evaluate the setting itself rather than inferring its medium from the giraffes.

node_traces.evidence: Compared with the photographic source, the edited setting has a coherent chalk-drawing appearance: the hillside and sky are rendered in broad, visibly textured strokes, vegetation is simplified into soft colored marks, and the ground and structures have sketchy, grainy shading and outlines. The setting reads as drawn rather than merely blurred or grain-filtered.
